Root cause. The legacy superblock parser accepts a 4-byte status word whose high bytes are nonzero because the only range check is a debug-only `HDassert`. In release builds the malformed 32-bit value is truncated to one byte and parsing continues on attacker-controlled legacy superblock state that should have been rejected.

`H5C__load_entry()` commits to that wrapped length by reallocating the root object-header image buffer using the short `actual_len` value.
